name: io.marginpad/marginpad
description: Free crypto-futures paper trading for AI agents and bots plus free market data: live prices, candles, a scored screener, funding, open interest, liquidations from 10 exchanges, and a full paper-trading account (open, close, limit and stop orders, trailing stops, books, reset, equity curve, replay of any past day). 27 tools. Market data needs no key; trading needs a free key from https://marginpad.io/trading-api/.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: MarginPad Bot API key (mpb_...). Optional: without it the market-data tools work, the paper-trading tools need it.
